stem: Tidal Metrics is right-sizing two services: one is CPU-bound and one is memory-bound. (Select TWO.)

choices.text: C family for the CPU-bound service
I family for the memory-bound service
R family for the memory-bound service

rationale: C families are designed for compute-optimized workloads, fitting the CPU-bound service. R families are designed for memory-optimized workloads, fitting the memory-bound service. Applying one family to both services usually overprovisions one resource dimension. I families target storage-optimized profiles rather than primary memory bottlenecks. Burstable T families are not the primary fit for sustained CPU-bound production tiers.
